comment: Per-device-type syslog catalog for cisco_asr9902 (IOS-XR 24.2.2). Overlays the universal catalog. Link entries are role-tagged, so an oper-status transition fires the XR LINK and LINEPROTO pair instead of the universal interface-up/down. Message text follows the Cisco IOS XR System Message Guide.

entries.name: xr-lineproto-updown-down
entries.template: %PKT_INFRA-LINEPROTO-5-UPDOWN : Line protocol on Interface {{.IfName}}, changed state to Down

entries.name: xr-lineproto-updown-up
entries.template: %PKT_INFRA-LINEPROTO-5-UPDOWN : Line protocol on Interface {{.IfName}}, changed state to Up

entries.name: xr-config-commit
entries.template: %MGBL-CONFIG-6-DB_COMMIT : Configuration committed by user 'admin'. Use 'show configuration commit changes 1000000001' to view the changes.
